name: Pevely Farms Golf Course
foot: Automatic page (not hand checked): course from OpenStreetMap, card from golfify, trees / long grass / water from the vision layer on USDA NAIP + USGS 3DEP lidar, OB inferred from the course outline and buildings. Solved tee sets: Black, Blue. See qa_report.md for the hole-by-hole checks.

review.why: NOT safe to publish: 4 holes (1, 9, 10, 18) play the neighbouring Crescent Farms holes

1: The page plays OSM hole way 884242539 (ref 1, hcp 9).
9: The page plays OSM way 884242547 (Crescent Farms hole 9, hcp 1). This is the neighbouring Crescent Farms Golf Club (OSM way 365165194), not Pevely Farms.
10: The page plays OSM way 884242548 (Crescent Farms hole 10). This is the neighbouring Crescent Farms Golf Club (OSM way 365165194), not Pevely Farms.
16: The geometry looks right (OSM boxes, card yardage, dogleg right at about 260 yds). The calm pick (2-wood/4-wood tie) aims +40 yds right, at the aim bound, and lands in rough by the trees at the corner with 2% fairway.
18: The page plays OSM way 884242556 (Crescent Farms hole 18, hcp 2). This is the neighbouring Crescent Farms Golf Club (OSM way 365165194), not Pevely Farms.
